versions.content: Specification of the destinationContext in a EcucIn- stanceReferenceDef The string entered as destinationContext shall be an ordered list of M2 class names defined in the metamodel [10] under 'M2::AUTOSAR Templates' as it is represented in the XML schema [11] separated by the SPACE char- acter. Additionally the '*' character can be used to indicate none or multiple occurrence of the M2 class BEFORE the '*' character.
